page.overview:
What is Abraxas Malfoy?

Abraxas Malfoy (fl. 1954–1968) was a pure-blood wizard, a member of the Malfoy family, father of Lucius Malfoy, grandfather of Draco Malfoy and great-grandfather of Scorpius Malfoy. He was related by marriage to the Blacks, through his daughter-in-law Narcissa, and, more distantly, to the Lestranges and Tonks families via Narcissa's two elder sisters.

Little is known about Abraxas's early life. If he attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, he was likely Sorted into Slytherin house, based on a statement of his grandson Draco Malfoy, although this is not confirmed yet.

Abraxas had at least one child, Lucius Malfoy, who was born in late 1953 or 1954; the identity, fate and whereabouts of Lucius's mother, Abraxas's wife or partner, is currently unknown. Abraxas apparently knew Horace Slughorn, the Head of Slytherin, according to his grandson Draco and Slughorn himself.

Abraxas Malfoy was widely believed to have been part of the shady plot that, in 1968, forced Minister for Magic Nobby Leach (the first Muggle-born ever to have held the office) to leave his post prematurely. Nothing was, however, conclusively proven against Malfoy.
